request_drafts.subject: Trade price file request for Example Ltd (fictional), account [account reference to be added]
request_drafts.body:
Dear Gamma (fictional) account team,

We only hold public list prices for Gamma (fictional), which we cannot rely on for our quotes. Could you send us the prices that apply to our trade account?

Please send us the following:
- The price file as a CSV or Excel file.
- The period the prices are valid for (valid from and valid until dates).
- Whether the prices include VAT or exclude it, stated once for the whole file.
- Your product code for each item, plus the manufacturer part number (MPN) and the barcode (GTIN) where you have them.
- The pack size each price is for, and the unit it is quoted per (each, per pack, per metre, per 100).
- Your delivery terms, including delivery charges and the order value above which delivery is free.
- Confirmation that we may load the file into a purchasing tool to compare prices for our own purchases.

Thank you. We will check the prices with you before we rely on them.

Alex Example
Example Ltd (fictional)
Account reference: [account reference to be added]
